 ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: Confident that Quad meeting will set concrete goals for next phase, says PM Modi 
 In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese 
 Updated - November 17, 2026 04:44 pm IST 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at a meeting with members of the Quad in Philippines. 
 | Photo Credit: 
 Reuters
 P rime Minister Narendra Modi participated in the 23rd ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations)-India summit and the 21st East Asia summit on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) in Manila. Philippines is hosting the summits in its capacity as the current chair of the 11-nation ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations). In a pre-departure statement, PM Modi said India’s relationship with the ASEAN region is at the “heart of India’s Act East Policy”.
 PM Modi is also expected to meet U.S. President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the first Quad Summit since 2024 in Manila , on the sidelines of ASEAN summits today (November 17, 2026), sources in New Delhi had confirmed to The Hindu . The meeting would probably take place after Mr. Trump lands in Manila. The confirmation of the Quad Summit in Manila is significant for the Indo-Pacific grouping, and plans to chart out their next course.
 Also read | The challenge of holding the Quad together

 Shami bowls last over vs Australia in T20 World Cup practice match; defends 10 and picks three wickets 
 President Donald Trump arrives in Manila 
 U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in Manila today, where he is scheduled to meet regional partners, talk trade, and seek a break from a series of setbacks at home.
 Upon his arrival, Mr. Trump was welcomed by Philippine Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Ilocos Norte Representative and presidential son Sandro Marcos, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez, U.S. Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton and Pasay City Mayor Emi Calixto.
 Manila is Mr. Trump’s first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, and, according to Mr. Trump, potentially for a meeting with North Korea’s leader Kim Jong Un.
 PTI and ANI 
 November 17, 2026 16:42 U.S. President Trump on China and rare earth production President Donald Trump said on the sidelines of a Manila summit that the United States would catch China in rare earths production “within 10 months”.
 “We are making rare earths at a level that we’ve never made before. We’re going to catch them within 10 months, they say,” he told reporters ahead of a meeting with the Quad security alliance countries.
 AFP 
 November 17, 2026 16:34 U.S. President Trump on Quad Speaking at a discussion with leaders of Japan, India, and Australia, U.S. President Trump said Quad represents some of the most successful partnerships in the world. 
 November 17, 2026 16:27 President Trump addresses Quad members 
 November 17, 2026 16:08 PM in Manila: Giving new momentum to India’s Act East Policy Strategic rivalries, economic disruption and anxieties over the international order give the ASEAN-India Summit an opportunity to reaffirm ASEAN centrality, consolidate the results of the 2026 ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation and add fresh momentum to India’s Act East Policy.
 Read more: ​ PM in Manila: Giving new momentum to India’s Act East Policy
 Modi’s Manila visit signals India’s Act East Policy deepening with ASEAN to shape a stable, inclusive Indo-Pacific through maritime, digital, and economic cooperation.
 ​
 November 17, 2026 15:44 Japan's PM proposes Asian energy agency Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has proposed the creation of an Asian energy agency to help countries in the region cope with oil crises. 
 Ms. Takaichi called for setting up an oil security task force and a Japan-based version of the International Energy Agency for the region.
 “We would like to position this as an Asian version of the IEA,” she said.
 AP 
 November 17, 2026 15:33 Joint statement between U.S. and Thailand in trade negotiations U.S. President Donald Trump will sign a joint statement with Thailand’s premier today, marking “significant progress” in trade negotiations, but will not ink a final deal, a Thai official said.
 A framework agreement was unveiled just over a year ago, on the same day as Trump announced a short-lived ceasefire between Thailand and its neighbour Cambodia following deadly border clashes.
 AFP 
 November 17, 2026 15:10 Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage Amid ASEAN members grappling with fuel shortages and price hikes, Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi said her country’s “hydro-tanks” would be available for use to the ASEAN countries under the proposed initiative for cooperation on oil stockpiling.
 Read more: ​ Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage
 Japan offers ASEAN access to its crude oil storage to bolster regional energy security amid supply pressures.
 ​
 November 17, 2026 15:03 ASEAN leaders on MSMEs and AI adoption ASEAN leaders have adopted the declaration to promote artificial intelligence (AI)-powered growth among micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), focusing on affordable technology solutions, digital infrastructure, AI literacy and responsible technology adoption across the region.
 The declaration recognises that MSMEs form the backbone of ASEAN economies but continue to face challenges in AI adoption.
 Under the declaration, ASEAN member states have been encouraged to explore voluntary and flexible approaches to assess the AI readiness of MSMEs and identify gaps in their technological capabilities.
 ASEAN leaders also identified AI literacy as a key requirement for responsible and sustainable adoption.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 14:52 PM Modi's proposal for increased youth engagement PM Modi has suggested an ASEAN-India Youth Connect initiative involving a youth summit, young parliamentarian exchanges and start-up hackathons, to strengthen people-to-people and youth engagement. 
 The PM also proposed enhancing scholarships for students from ASEAN countries at Nalanda University.
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 14:46 India's proposals to strengthen ties with ASEAN A series of proposals were outlined in a Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) statement following the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila on Tuesday.
 Among them is a long-term ASEAN-India Maritime Cooperation Plan covering connectivity, scientific research, disaster management, Coast Guard cooperation, maritime domain awareness and seafarers’ security.
 A joint cyber forensics training programme to build capacity in the region and ASEAN-India technical exchanges in nuclear energy were also proposed. 
 Other proposals include an ASEAN-India Space Hackathon and cooperation in mining and critical minerals.
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 14:41 India proposes free e-visas for ASEAN tourists Prime Minister Narendra Modi has proposed free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries as an initiative to strengthen India-ASEAN ties. 
 This was outlined in a Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) statement following the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit today. 
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 14:30 Japan to give ASEAN countries access to its crude oil storage facilities Japan said today in Manila that Southeast Asian nations will be able to access its crude oil storage facilities as part of efforts to prepare the region for a future energy crisis.
 Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said her country’s “hydro-tanks” would be available for use under the proposed initiative for cooperation on oil stockpiling.
 “We have suggested to utilise our crude oil stockpiling facilities in Japan, which is not utilised,” Japan’s Foreign Ministry Press Secretary Toshihiro Kitamura said. 
 In the longer term, Tokyo plans to assist ASEAN countries to build their own “stockpiling facilities”.
 AFP 
 November 17, 2026 14:25 Leaders, protesters await Donald Trump's arrival for Manila summit Around 2000 demonstrators were facing off in Manila, prior to President Trump’s arrival in Philippines, while carrying banners reading Trump out now and Reject Pax Silica. 
 Read more: Leaders, protesters await Donald Trump arrival for Manila summit
 Protests erupt as Trump arrives in Manila for ASEAN and Quad talks amid Pax Silica backlash and global tariff debates.
 November 17, 2026 14:11 Indo-ASEAN ties at the heart of India’s Act East Policy, PM says ahead of ASEAN summit in Manila Prime Minister Modi on Monday said that his visit to Philippines is expected to strengthen the “collective commitment to a peaceful, prosperous and resilient Indo-Pacific”. Read more: Indo-ASEAN ties at the heart of India’s Act East Policy, PM says ahead of ASEAN summit in Manila
 Modi's Manila visit for ASEAN-India and East Asia summits aims to advance Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, boosting growth, connectivity, and Indo-Pacific stability.
 November 17, 2026 13:58 PM Modi's speech at the ASEAN-India Summit Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s remarks at the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila today. 
 ​ ​
 November 17, 2026 13:40 India-ASEAN Summit's talks on disaster management India and ASEAN, today in Manila, agreed to deepen cooperation on disaster management, including through enhanced early warning systems, sharing of satellite and meteorological data, joint preparedness exercises and rapid deployment of humanitarian assistance.
 The agreement was mentioned in a joint statement issued after the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit.
 It said, India and ASEAN, which are both exposed to hazards including earthquakes, tsunamis, floods, cyclones, extreme heat and landslides, recognised the need to build a disaster-resilient region.
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 13:32 PM Modi presented with the book ‘Bombay: A True-Blue Filipino’ In Manila yesterday, PM Modi was presented with the book ‘Bombay: A True-Blue Filipino,’ by former Ambassador of the Philippines to India, Mr. Ramon S. Bagatsing Jr. and members of his family.
 November 17, 2026 13:07 Our future must be shaped by ‘cooperation, not competition’: PM Modi to ASEAN leaders Prime Minister Modi said India and ASEAN have both the strength and the resolve and together, both sides can make this region a symbol of peace and stability.
 Read more: ​ Our future must be shaped by ‘cooperation, not competition’: PM Modi to ASEAN leaders
 Modi urges ASEAN leaders to choose cooperation over competition, reaffirming India's steadfast partnership and shared goals for a peaceful, prosperous Indo-Pacific.
 ​
 November 17, 2026 12:55 PM Modi leads foundation stone-laying ceremony for Philippines’ oldest gurudwara’s redevelopment PM Narendra Modi, while visiting a gurudwara in the Philippines, said he felt “very blessed” to visit the over a century-old Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila.
 Read more: ​ PM Modi leads foundation stone-laying ceremony for Philippines’ oldest gurudwara’s redevelopment
 Modi lays foundation for redevelopment of the Philippines' oldest gurudwara during a visit highlighting India-Philippines ties.
 ​
 November 17, 2026 12:55 Granthi of Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan on PM Modi Members of the Sikh community in the Philippines have expressed immense pride and gratitude after Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday led the foundation-stone laying ceremony for the redevelopment of Manila’s historic Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan, a century-old place of worship.
 “Narendra Modi ji is a very religious man; he is particularly knowledgeable about the Sikh faith. He is very well-versed in matters concerning Gurdwaras and has a deep, genuine affection for the Sikh community,” said Baba Manmohan Singh, Granthi of Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 12:47 PM Modi on ASEAN's importance for India PM Modi highlighted growing connectivity between India and ASEAN, saying direct flights between India and nine ASEAN countries, along with increasing tourism, reflected the strength of their partnership.
 “This is my third visit to an ASEAN country this year. This demonstrates the special importance that ASEAN has for India. Our belief is that India’s development and ASEAN’s prosperity are very closely linked to each other,” he said.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 12:46 PM Modi about initiatives and projects undertaken in India Speaking at the India-ASEAN Summit, PM Modi said that India had undertaken more than 100 initiatives to strengthen people-to-people ties since 2014, while over 250 Quick Impact Projects had been launched and more than 10,000 skill-building scholarships provided.
 November 17, 2026 12:40 India at the AZEC Leaders’ Meeting in Manila Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri represented India at the 4th Asia Zero Emission Community (AZEC) Leaders’ Meeting in Manila on Tuesday, where India welcomed Japan’s BRIDGE Asia initiative. 
 November 17, 2026 12:35 PM Modi on peace and stability In the India-ASEAN Summit, PM Modi stated that the world has faced several challenges in the last few years and today it needs peace, stability and predictability.
 “I am confident that today’s meeting will elevate our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership to new heights and contribute to building a secure, inclusive, and prosperous Indo-Pacific,” PM Modi said. 
 “Together, we must chart a new direction for future of our region,” he added. 
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 12:28 Xi, Carney call for deeper ties as Canada looks beyond U.S. for trade As Chinese President Xi Jinping and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney met ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ summit today, both the countries have called for deeper ties as Ottawa navigates strained relations with the United States and seeks closer cooperation with Beijing.
 Read more: Xi, Carney call for deeper ties as Canada looks beyond U.S. for trade
 Canada-Chi Jn: Xi and Carney push deeper ties amid shifting US-Canada trade, noting rising predictability and a tariff-reducing EV agreement.
 November 17, 2026 12:20 PM Modi on Act East Policy PM Modi stated that the Act East Policy has given fresh momentum and depth to India-ASEAN relations. 
 “In our collaboration, India’s commitment to ASEAN’s unity and centrality is and will remain unwavering,’ he added. 
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 12:15 PM Modi at the India-ASEAN Summit “India, ASEAN represent around one-fourth of global population; it is important to decide our future by cooperation; not by competition,” PM Modi said in the India-ASEAN Summit in Manila today. 
 “We believe that India’s development and ASEAN’s prosperity are deeply interconnected,” he added. 
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 12:04 Embassy of India in Philippines to resume services from Wednesday The Embassy of India in Manila will resume all regular consular services, passport applications and visa processing from Wednesday, following a temporary suspension in view of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and East Asia Summit.
 According to the earlier advisory, the closure was in accordance with Proclamation No. 1447 issued by the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, declaring special non-working days in the National Capital Region (NCR) for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 11:54 ASEAN-Japan Summit held in Manila today Joint Statement of the 29th ASEAN-Japan Summit on Realising Economic Resilience was adopted today in Manila, with the meeting being attended by the Leaders of ASEAN Member States, the Prime Minister of Japan H.E. Sanae Takaichi, and Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn.
 November 17, 2026 11:46 Japan's PM Sanae Takaichi pledges to work with ASEAN In the ASEAN leaders’ meeting today, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged to work with ASEAN to boost regional economic and energy resilience to address export restrictions and vulnerabilities from rapid AI development, and strengthen supply chains, including on critical minerals.
 A Japanese Foreign Ministry official said it was expected that Quad leaders would try to show unity, with maritime security, export restrictions, critical-minerals supply-chain diversification and AI among potential discussion points.
 November 17, 2026 11:37 President Trump to visit China U.S. President Donald Trump is scheduled to arrive in China on Wednesday, for an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, following his meeting with the Quad leaders today. 
 This Quad alliance is heavily criticised by China, given that one of its purposes is to support Indo-Pacific nations in strengthening their sovereignty and simultaneously constrain China’s attempts to undermine that capacity-building.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 11:21 PM Modi to attend Quad leaders' meeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to attend the Quad leaders’ meeting, the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit during his ongoing visit to the Philippines, External Affairs Ministry (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said on Tuesday.
 This marks the first in-person, leaders-level Quad gathering since September 2024 in Delaware, as well as the first since Donald Trump returned to the White House.
 ANI 
 November 17, 2026 11:03 Possible protests against President Donald Trump's visit U.S. President Donald Trump flies into the Philippines on Tuesday ‌at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit.
 There could be protests in Manila against Mr. Trump’s visit, after days of demonstrations that have included the burning of effigies of the President and calls for an end to ‌the West Asia war and the scrapping of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative.
 Reuters 
 November 17, 2026 10:46 Prime Minister Modi visits gurudwara in Philippines Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday visited the oldest gurudwara in the Philippines and led the foundation stone-laying ceremony for its redevelopment.
 “The Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara has stood as a testament to the vibrant India-Philippines cultural and people-to-people ties for over a century,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said in a social media post.
 PTI 
 November 17, 2026 10:45 Final day of the 49th ASEAN summit “ASEAN Leaders and their counterparts from ASEAN’s External Partners convene today in Manila, the Philippines, for the final day of the 49th ASEAN Summit,” ASEAN’s X page said.
 “The meetings provide an opportunity to review progress in regional cooperation, exchange views on regional and international developments, and advance partnerships across ASEAN-led mechanisms,” it added.
